# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via GitHub's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/plasma-flux-explorer/security/advisories/new) feature. Include as much detail as possible: a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

Please include a description of the affected component, steps to reproduce the issue, and its potential impact. The maintainers will acknowledge the report and coordinate any fix and disclosure through the advisory.
